# Subtopology Decomposition

Each subsystem will be assembled as an F' subtopology containing its application, hardware managers, and driver connections. The diagrams below show the intended software boundaries. Detailed FPP instances, ports, and connections remain TBA until the corresponding topology designs are finalized.

## ADCS

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    A[AdcsApplication] --> B[ADCS hardware managers]
    B --> C[Linux drivers]
    A -. mode command .-> D[SatStateMachine]
```

## Payload and Data Collection

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    A[DataCollectionApplication] --> B[Payload hardware managers]
    A --> C[Data products and storage]
    B --> D[Linux drivers]
```

GNSS is treated as a payload/data-collection hardware manager for this document. Camera and star-tracker manager designs remain TBA.

## Communications

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    A[ComApplication] --> B[TmtcRadioManager]
    B --> C[LinuxUartDriver]
    A --> D[CCSDS service components]
```

## Electrical Power System

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    A[EPSApplication] --> B[EPS hardware managers]
    B --> C[Linux I2C and GPIO drivers]
```

## Thermal

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    A[ThermalApplication] --> B[TemperatureSensorManager]
    A --> C[HeaterManager]
    B --> D[LinuxI2cDriver]
    C --> E[LinuxPwmDriver]
```
